mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_id, started_at, expires_at, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_subscription ( user_id, product_id, started_at, expires_at, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productId}, #{startedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status} )

where.if: AND ( account.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND account.status = 1 AND product.status = 1 AND subscription.status = 1 AND subscription.expires_at > #{currentTime}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_subscription subscription INNER JOIN user_account account ON account.id = subscription.user_id INNER JOIN product product ON product.id = subscription.product_id

SELECT subscription.id, subscription.user_id, account.username, account.nickname, account.status AS user_status, subscription.product_id, product.product_code, product.product_name, product.status AS product_status, subscription.status, subscription.started_at, subscription.expires_at, subscription.created_at, subscription.updated_at FROM user_subscription subscription INNER JOIN user_account account ON account.id = subscription.user_id INNER JOIN product product ON product.id = subscription.product_id
ORDER BY subscription.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
